about_the_game:
A Puzzle Unfolds to the Rhythm


Drill Beat is a puzzle-rhythm game where movement is driven by music. You control an animated drill bit that can only move to the beat, challenging you to time every step. Navigate through a series of intricate puzzles, avoid hazards, and find the best path forward as you collect golden cogs to unlock new stages.

As you descend deeper into this mechanical world, the puzzles grow more complex, requiring a mix of rhythm, strategy, and quick thinking. With a unique blend of timing-based movement and puzzle-solving, Drill Beat delivers a fresh and engaging experience for players who enjoy both rhythm and logic-based challenges.

Can you make it to the bottom?
